mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user_info WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_info r ON ur.role_info_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_info_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_str FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_info_id = rp.role_info_id INNER JOIN sys_permission_info p ON rp.permission_info_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_info_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.permission_str IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_str != ''

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_info_id = rp.role_info_id INNER JOIN sys_permission_info p ON rp.permission_info_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_info_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
